description: Generate an image from a text prompt with FLUX.1 schnell: send a prompt, get a 1024x1024 JPEG back as base64 in a few seconds, with an optional steps setting (1-8) for more detail. Use for illustrations, thumbnails, mockups, avatars, product shots and social media images inside an agent workflow. Example: prompt=a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset, watercolor. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
